title: farewell exits 0 when the name is missing
body:
## Status
Ready for /harness:work.

## Problem
`bash farewell.sh` (no argument) prints the usage line but exits 0 (`farewell.sh:3`). The README says it exits 2, and scripts calling it cannot detect the mistake.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `bash farewell.sh` exits 2 and prints the usage line on stderr.
- [ ] `tests/farewell.sh` gains a case for the missing name.

## Touches
farewell.sh
tests/farewell.sh
